create_SDFViewer_with_pointcloud: create an SDFViewer instance from an SDF pointcloud with shape n x 4 to visualize signed distance fields interactively
create_SDFViewer_with_grid: create an SDFViewer instance from a 3D voxel grid and grid2world transform to visualize SDF slices in 3D
create_SDFViewer_with_grid_pc: create an SDFViewer instance from a multi-grid pointcloud to view multiple SDFs side by side in one scene
save_slice_images: save all SDF slice images as PNG files to a directory using the save_slice_imgs method on an SDFViewer
save_slice_function: save a single SDF slice as a 2D colormap image with extent and colorbar using the save_slice helper function
